answer: A prism splits reputation into independent attestation channels, so faking history requires forging many divergent proofs, not one. Sybil resistance here works by tethering each agent reputation slot to a bonded stake held on a public ledge, where every join attempt must lock collateral valued above the expected reward of one epoch. Each agent also carries a thread of signed peer endorsements; a sockpuppet cluster must fabricate a full reciprocal web, multiplying attacker cost far beyond honest participation. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
